'''Portho Kaltemmic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was the head of one of the [[Three Families]] on [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

During the [[Quesh war]], Portho allied himself with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] and the Sith Empire, who later betrayed and assassinated him.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Portho was one of the three heads of the [[Three Families]] circa [[3642 BBY]] on [[Quesh]] and had indulged in the [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] that the families had in their [[Three Families Palace|palace]].<ref name="Three Families Palace" /> After many years of the adrenals abuse and after several conversations with Republic officials that proved to be embarrassing, the families tended to keep Portho out of sight.<ref name="Three Families Palace" /> Portho also had green skin.
